product.title: Private Seattle City and Snoqualmie Falls Tour

description.text: Explore Seattle and Snoqualmie Falls on a private five-hour tour with a dedicated driver-guide. The flexible route covers city landmarks such as Kerry Park and Pike Place Market before continuing east to the 268-foot Snoqualmie Falls overlook.

highlights: Private five-hour Seattle and Snoqualmie Falls tour
Dedicated driver-guide for your group only
Flexible city stops including Kerry Park
Visit the famous Snoqualmie Falls overlook
Hotel or cruise port pickup available

start.description: Private pickup from your Seattle hotel, cruise port, or confirmed central meeting point.

end.description: Return to your Seattle hotel or cruise port.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore Seattle and Snoqualmie Falls on a private five-hour tour with a dedicated driver-guide.

itineraryItems.title: Seattle city highlights
itineraryItems.description: Drive to selected Seattle landmarks such as Kerry Park, Pike Place Market, or the Space Needle area.

itineraryItems.title: Snoqualmie Falls
itineraryItems.description: Travel east to the 268-foot Snoqualmie Falls overlook and surrounding park viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Scenic return drive
itineraryItems.description: Return toward Seattle through Cascade foothill scenery with flexible photo stops when time allows.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
